mapper.sql: SELECT s.stock_id, s.book_id, i.book_name, i.isbn, i.author, i.publisher, i.major, s.stock_num, s.storage_addr, s.warning_num, s.total_purchase, s.total_issued, s.stock_status, s.version, s.update_time, s.del_flag FROM textbook_stock s LEFT JOIN textbook_info i ON s.book_id = i.book_id
mapper.select:
WHERE s.del_flag = '0' AND i.book_name LIKE CONCAT('%',#{bookName},'%') AND i.isbn = #{isbn} AND i.author LIKE CONCAT('%',#{author},'%') AND i.publisher LIKE CONCAT('%',#{publisher},'%')
AND s.stock_num <= 0 AND s.stock_num > 0 AND s.stock_num <= COALESCE(s.warning_num, 10) AND s.stock_num > COALESCE(s.warning_num, 10) AND s.stock_status = #{stockStatus}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO textbook_stock(book_id, stock_num, storage_addr, warning_num, version, del_flag) VALUES(#{bookId}, #{stockNum}, #{storageAddr}, #{warningNum}, 0, '0')
mapper.update:
UPDATE textbook_stock
stock_num=#{stockNum}, storage_addr=#{storageAddr}, warning_num=#{warningNum}, stock_status=#{stockStatus}, update_time=NOW(), WHERE stock_id=#{stockId} AND del_flag='0'
mapper.delete: UPDATE textbook_stock SET del_flag='1' WHERE stock_id=#{stockId}
UPDATE textbook_stock SET del_flag='1' WHERE stock_id IN #{stockId}
mapper.select: SELECT COALESCE(stock_num, 0) FROM textbook_stock WHERE book_id = #{bookId} AND del_flag = '0'
SELECT COALESCE(version, 0) FROM textbook_stock WHERE book_id = #{bookId} AND del_flag = '0'
mapper.update: UPDATE textbook_stock SET stock_num = stock_num + #{qty}, version = version + 1, total_purchase = COALESCE(total_purchase, 0) + #{qty}, update_time = NOW() WHERE book_id = #{bookId} AND version = #{version} AND del_flag = '0'
